repeated small vertical marks/signs in a row
justification: The only correspondence is generic: both surfaces show rows of small, repeated humanoid figures standing on horizontal lines within banded registers, something almost any figural tradition could produce. A depicts boats with crews as its entire subject, drawn in bare linear silhouette, while B shows a modelled scene of larger figures with a rayed disc, an offering table and dense columns of sign-writing, with no watercraft at all.
